risk_note: RV2 (db/migrations/** funds path). Migration pay-core: pay_orders, pay_notifications, pay_query_attempts, pay_refunds, pay_anomalies, pay_fulfillments (04 §3.2 rows plus pay_fulfillments per orchestrator ruling D10-168 ②), named constraints and indexes, partial unique (app_id, biz_type, biz_ref) WHERE status IN (PENDING, PAID), immutable-column triggers on out_trade_no / amount_fen / out_refund_no, insert-only guards, grants to couli_app only; db/schema.sql and packages/db/src/db.gen.ts regenerated on the test machine; the funds lock list of tools/ci/lint-migrations.test.ts gains the six tables (class-3 path allowed by the ledger, as B2-02c). Rule tests by Codex (18 connected cases), red on the AWS test machine; spec-test review by a fresh Claude subagent (pass); implementation (SQL only) by a Claude Opus 5.5 subagent; Codex money review round 1 pass. Depends on B2-15g (pay_ prefix). Orchestrated by pay-acct4 (Claude Fable 5.1). Ledger PR #1187.
